entities.summary: Staffan Hellstrand (b. 1956-05-13, Stockholm) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Stockholm and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
